news.views module

Server-rendered browsing, subscriptions and editorial workspace.

Access control uses login_required for signed-in pages and the shared news.access rules for per-object checks. A failed check raises PermissionDenied (HTTP 403) or returns 404 for hidden drafts.

news.views.home(request)[source]

List approved articles, with an optional title/content search.

news.views.register(request)[source]

Sign up a new reader, log them in and send them to subscriptions.

Public registration always creates a reader; other roles are assigned by an administrator.

news.views.subscriptions(request)[source]

Let a reader choose the publishers and journalists they follow.

news.views.feed(request)[source]

Show a reader the approved articles from their subscriptions.

news.views.article_detail(request, pk)[source]

Show one article, with edit/approve controls for staff.

Drafts the user may not see return 404, so their existence is not revealed.

news.views.workspace(request)[source]

List the articles a journalist wrote or an editor oversees.

news.views.article_edit(request, pk=None)[source]

Create an article (journalists) or edit one (author/editor).

Saving always sends the article for editorial review.

news.views.article_approve(request, pk)[source]

Approve an article (editors only) and report notification status.

This is the brief’s option 2: the approval view triggers the email and the /api/approved/ POST through approve_article. POST-only so a link or prefetch cannot approve an article by accident.

news.views.delete_content(request, kind, pk)[source]

Confirm (GET) and delete (POST) an article or newsletter.

kind comes from the URL configuration, not from user input.

news.views.newsletters(request)[source]

List all newsletters for anyone to browse.

news.views.newsletter_detail(request, pk)[source]

Show a newsletter and only its currently approved articles.

news.views.newsletter_edit(request, pk=None)[source]

Create a newsletter (journalist/editor) or edit one (owner/editor).

news.views.newsletter_send(request, pk)[source]

Email a newsletter to subscribers, reporting any failure.
